name: Garam masala
ingredients_raw: Coriander, Chilli, Cumin, Black Pepper, Fenugreek, Mustard, Cassia, Curry Leaves, Cereal Grain, Purely Natural Spices in Powder Form. PROPRIETARY FOOD Directions for use: Prepare the Vegetables of your choice with usual spices in Ghee/Oil as you normally do. Add 1½ tsp Teju Garam Masala. Stir Vegetables on low flame for 3 mins. Keep covered for at least 5 minutes, so that the Vegetables retain the flavour and aroma of Teju Garam Masala (500gms Vegetables or 1 Ltr. ready dal needs 1½ tsp Garam Masala). Dal, Samosa, Potato Vada, Kachori, Usal, Patties, Patra and all types of farsans taste best with Teju Garam Masala.
